title: CP²N² — Control Plane for Physical Neural Networks (v5.1.1)
description: CP²N² is a substrate-neutral control plane for heterogeneous physical neural network resources. Version v5.1.1 publishes the complete A6/RQ2 same-host reference run and synchronizes the selector artifacts with the current implementation. The Cortical Labs integration remains E3 SDK-simulator evidence; this release makes no claim of physical CL1 execution or biological performance.
